description: This file defines the SNComponent class representing a component within a synchronization system. It includes properties such as URL, package info, area, permissions, validation, activation status, and methods to check conflict strategy, handle display name, determine if it is an editor or theme, and other utility functions related to component behavior.

classes.name: SNComponent
classes.description: Represents a component item that is typically iframe-based, with properties and methods to manage its URLs, permissions, state, and behavior within the application. It extends DecryptedItem and implements ComponentInterface.

methods.name: strategyWhenConflictingWithItem
methods.description: Defines the conflict resolution strategy when conflicting with another item, defaults to keeping the base version.

methods.name: isEditor
methods.description: Checks if the component is an editor based on its area.

methods.name: isTheme
methods.description: Checks if the component is a theme or associated with themes.

methods.name: legacyIsDefaultEditor
methods.description: Checks if the component is marked as the default editor (legacy).

methods.name: getLastSize
methods.description: Retrieves the last size data stored for the component.

methods.name: getClientDataKey
methods.description: Returns the key used to store or retrieve client-specific data, preferring legacy_url if available.

methods.name: hasValidHostedUrl
methods.description: Determines if the component has a valid hosted URL.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies content keys to ignore during equality checks to prevent unnecessary differences.

methods.name: associativeAreas
methods.description: Returns the list of areas where components are considered associative.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Checks if the component is in an area where it is considered associative.

methods.name: isExplicitlyEnabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if the component is explicitly enabled for a specific item by UUID.

methods.name: isExplicitlyDisabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if the component is explicitly disabled for a specific item by UUID.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines if the component's valid until date has passed.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Gets the feature identifier from package info.

methods.name: thirdPartyPackageInfo
methods.description: Returns third-party feature details from package info.

methods.name: noteType
methods.description: Gets the note type associated with the component's package info.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the component is marked as deprecated based on its flags.

methods.name: deprecationMessage
methods.description: Provides the deprecation message if available.

ctags.name: SNComponent
ctags.pattern: /^export class SNComponent extends DecryptedItem<ComponentContent> implements ComponentInterface {$/

ctags.name: isComponent
ctags.pattern: /^export const isComponent = (x: ItemInterface): x is SNComponent => x.content_type === ContentTyp/

ctags.name: isComponentOrTheme
ctags.pattern: /^export const isComponentOrTheme = (x: ItemInterface): x is SNComponent =>$/
